item.description: Actress Doris Ogala has clashed with comedian Akpororo over his advice regarding her ongoing controversy with Chris Okafor, founder of Mountain of Liberation and Miracle Ministries. item.title: ‘It won’t be business as usual’ — Mercy Johnson warns after dropping defamation suit against TikToker
item.description: Mercy Johnson, the Nollywood actress, has dropped the defamation charge she filed against TikToker Eedie Bliss. Bliss was arrested last week for allegedly making defamatory statements about the actress and her husband Odianosen Okojie. item.title: Police file cyberbullying charges against Activist Adetoun over ‘online attacks’ on Gov. Abiodun
item.description: The police command in Ogun has filed a six-count charge against Adetoun Onajobi, an activist, over allegations of cyberbullying Dapo Abiodun, governor of the state. The charges were filed at the federal high court in Abeokuta, Ogun state capital. item.title: Police arrest suspect over Destiny Boy’s death
item.description: The Ogun state police command has arrested one suspect in connection with the death of Fuji singer Destiny Boy. News of the singer’s demise circulated on social media on Sunday.
